_: What is true right now, for the managers. This is the one place that is kept current: WhatsApp messages go out, get corrected, and are read out of order. Edit this file whenever something is settled or changes, and change `updated` to that day.
agreed: The week runs Monday to Sunday. Counting starts Monday 9 November.
A tester is paid for each app tested: 100 KES a small app, 150 a normal one, 250 a big one.
Plus 50 KES for a report that finds a real problem — nobody has to confirm it — and 100 KES in any week they use an app on 5 days out of 7.
A report the app accepted is a paid test. Failing the challenge does not cost the tester the money.

This page is yours alone. Emmanuel sees team 1, Veronicah sees team 2.
Some of what you are owed is the Zuri closing pay, marked on the row it belongs to. It is paid the same way as testing pay.
